1. वि-√ मुच् P. Ā. -मुञ्चति, ˚ते (Impv. -मुमोक्तु, RV. i, 24, 13), to unloose, unharness (Ā. ‘one's own horses’), unyoke (i.e. ‘make to halt, cause to stop or rest’), RV. &c. &c.; to take off (clothes, ornaments &c.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to release, set free, liberate, ib.; to leave, abandon, quit, desert, give up, relinquish, ib.; to shun, avoid, MuṇḍUp.; Bhag. &c.; to lose (consciousness), Hariv.; to pardon, forgive, Gīt.; BhP.; to emit, discharge, shed, pour or send forth, MBh.; R.; Pañcat. (with ग्रस्तम्, to set free a seized planet i.e. ‘free it from eclipse’, Sūryas.); to throw, hurl, cast (with आत्मानम् and loc., ‘to cast one's self into’, Uttarar.), MBh.; R. &c.; to utter (a sound), MBh.; to assume (a shape), Mn. i, 56; to lay (eggs), Pañcat. i, 353/354; Pass. -मुच्यते, to be unloosed or detached &c.; to be slackened (as reins), Śak.; to drop or be expelled (prematurely, as a fetus), Suśr.; to be freed or delivered or released (esp. from the bonds of existence), get rid of, escape from (abl. adv. in -तस्, gen., or instr.), Mn.; MBh. &c.; to be deprived of (instr.), Hit. : Caus. -मोचयति, to loosen, detach, Śak.; to unyoke, Kauś.; to set free, deliver from (abl.), Mn.; MBh. &c.; to keep off, avoid, R. : Desid. -मुमुक्षति, ˚ते, to wish to liberate (Ā. ‘one's self’), BhP.
2. वि-मुच् f. unyoking, alighting, stopping, putting up, RV. (विमुचो नपात्, ‘son of unyoking’, N. of Pūṣan as ‘conductor on the way to the next world’, ib.)
a: विमुच् — {c6c} P. 1 To free, liberate. --2 To loosen, unbind, unfasten, untie आसीद्विवृत्तवदना च विमोचयंती ( वल्कलं) Ś. 2. 12. --3 To give up, lay aside, abandon, quit; विमुच्य वासांसि गुरूनि सांप्रतं Rs. 1. 7. --4 To let go, let loose; Bk. 7. 50. --5 To except, set aside, set apart; Ku. 4. 31. --6 To shed, pour down (te ars); चिरमश्रूणि विमुच्य राघवः R. 8. 25. --7 To throw, cast. --8 To take off (clothes), undress oneself. --9 To stop, cease. --10 To take, assume. --Pass. To be deprived of, be freed from.
